newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Smallholder up 1.67 pct on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Smallholder up 1.67 pct on retail buying.

text.p: Shares of Tea Smallholder Factories Ltd rose 1.67 percent or 75 cents to 45.75 rupees in early Thursday trade, on retail buying, brokers said.
"Retailers are going for the share because not only is it liquid and cheap, it is also considered a growth stock," said a local broker.
The company, which prcesses tea leaf bought from small cultivators, said net profit for the 12 months ended March 31, 1997 rose by 65 percent to 82.80 million rupees.
Analysts say the company should see profit growth of at least 40 percent in the currnt financial year.
